habitat: Singly or in pairs in moist grassland with scattered trees. It is terrestrial and calls from the top of a bush.
summary: A common resident. Yellow eyebrows and feather edges, yellow below with a black gorget, and a yellow throat rather than the orange throat of Cape Longclaw. Upperparts are scalloped brown and the legs are pink-brown. Flight shows broad white tail-tips. The call is a monotonous mewing triooo, triooo, trroo-chit-chit. It also sings in flight. The Kemp code VB was left unchanged.

calls.description: A monotonous mewing from the top of a bush: triooo, triooo, trroo-chit-chit, trroo-chit-chit-trroo-chit. It also sings in flight. Grade A call from near Bikourou, Ngounié, Gabon. The filename is XC1011803-MLB_250508_MACCRO1_10.6kmSW_Bikourou_Ngounié_GABON.mp3. It was the only openly licensed grade A recording.

research.note: Newman calls it a common resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. Cape Longclaw and Bokmakierie are the comparisons Newman names and are not in this list. Pink-brown legs are not stored as a colour token. The Kemp code VB was left unchanged.
